analysis_type: Retrospective offline reanalysis of already known results; not prospective confirmation or a detector benchmark.

rules.empty_output: Flag omission only when returned forest length is zero.
rules.representative_exists: Treat the designated earlier mature output still in the returned union as sufficient preservation.
rules.final_only: Judge the selected position witness only at the final recorded epoch.
rules.rejection_is_loss: Treat any recorded candidate rejection as harmful whole-output omission.
rules.patch_consensus: Treat equal whole-output representations across selected repairs as sufficient semantic correctness.
rules.designated_witness: Independently check declared feasibility and finite whole-output position membership; do not infer continuous soundness from presence.

validation_tolerances.position: Exact serialized interval membership; no expanded boundary tolerance.
validation_tolerances.model_feasibility: fractions.Fraction for model fields and bounded-acceleration reference.
validation_tolerances.sensor_feasibility: strict geometric panel-intersection bounds; comparison tolerance 1e-12 only for reported arithmetic equality.
validation_tolerances.parity: Exact JSON forest/state equality; recorded depth SHA256 or array equality as explicitly identified.
validation_tolerances.velocity: independently evaluate sqrt(97); absolute arithmetic agreement tolerance 1e-12.

stop: Complete declared seven evidence groups, including negative and unresolved records. No native replay, sweep, new detector training, or source intervention.
limits: Selected cases are not independent random samples.
Return-level evidence is distinct from downstream caller consumption.
Archived old checker queries remain a different fixture from sensor scenes.
